snippet.title: The Mosquito Gang - Release trailer! Available now!
snippet.description:
​Enter the chaotic world of The Mosquito Gang, an asymmetrical multiplayer game where the eternal struggle between humans and mosquitoes comes to life. In this cooperative experience, one player embodies the Exterminator, tasked with household chores like fixing toilets and repairing electrical wiring, all while fending off a relentless gang of four bloodthirsty mosquitoes controlled by other players. ​

Steam page: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2811100/The_Mosquito_Gang/

As a mosquito, your mission is to stealthily extract blood from the human to unlock new abilities through a rogue-lite progression system, enhancing your prowess in this intense battle. Meanwhile, the Exterminator can utilize a variety of tools—from fly swatters and chemical sprays to advanced gadgets like ultrasonic devices—to eliminate the pesky intruders. ​

The Mosquito Gang offers a unique blend of cooperative and competitive gameplay, challenging players to strategize and adapt in this dynamic fight between man and insect. Dive into this thrilling adventure and determine which side will prevail in the ultimate showdown.​
